question: Who among the following won Arjuna Award 2021 in Para Archery discipline?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Harvinder Singh.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Harvinder Singh **won the Arjuna award in 2021 in the **Para Archery discipline.**
 
• **Arjuna Award__:**
 __
 
• **​**Arjuna Award for outstanding performance in Sports and Games is given for good performance over a period of the previous four years and for showing qualities of leadership, sportsmanship, and a sense of discipline.
 
 
 
• ​The Arjuna award was the highest sporting honor in India.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• 15 August 2015, Abhishek Verma won a gold medal in the compound men's individual section at the Archery World Cup Stage 3 in Wroclaw, Poland.
 
• Rishabh Yadav, and Jawkar Samadhan have won the **second gold** for India at Asia Archery Cup.
 
• **Aman Saini** is an Indian archer. He won the silver medal Asian Games 2018 in the Men's compound archery team event.
